title: Co-adaptive Rule Routing and Constraining for Structured Knowledge Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.14465v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Structured knowledge retrieval acquires task-relevant evidence from structured knowledge sources for downstream tasks. Existing methods rely on unconstrained retrieval or predefined query-rule supervision, such as author-paper rules for scientific discovery and anatomy-drug rules for precision medicine. Such supervision is rarely available in practice. We propose Co-Adaptive Rule Routing and Constraining Retrieval (CoRE), which jointly learns which reasoning rule to assign to each query and how to retrieve evidence under that rule, without predefined query-rule pairs. A routing agent selects a rule, and its corresponding retriever traverses the knowledge base and ranks evidence that satisfies the rule's constraints. Because routing and retrieval are interdependent, CoRE alternates between reinforcement learning for the routing policy and contrastive learning for the rule-constrained retriever. translated_title: 面向结构化知识检索的协同自适应规则路由与约束
translated_abstract: 结构化知识检索旨在从结构化知识源中获取与任务相关的证据，以支持下游任务。现有方法依赖无约束检索或预定义的查询-规则监督，例如科学发现中的作者-论文规则和精准医学中的解剖-药物规则，但这类监督在实际中很少可得。我们提出了协同自适应规则路由与约束检索方法，它无需预定义的查询-规则对，即可联合学习为每个查询分配何种推理规则以及如何在该规则下检索证据。路由代理选择一个规则，其对应的检索器遍历知识库并对满足规则约束的证据进行排序。由于路由与检索相互依赖，CoRE在路由策略的强化学习与规则约束检索器的对比学习之间交替进行。所选规则为……
tldr: CoRE无需预定义查询-规则对，通过交替进行路由策略的强化学习与规则约束检索器的对比学习，联合学习查询的规则分配及该规则约束下的证据检索，实现协同自适应的结构化知识检索。
en_tdlr: CoRE jointly learns which reasoning rule to assign to each query and how to retrieve evidence under that rule without predefined query-rule pairs, by alternating reinforcement learning for the routing policy and contrastive learning for the rule-constrained retriever.
